scope: Redesign equipment carriers around the selected bought carbon FPV adapter, simplify fixed optical and optional power supports, preserve intentionally separate propulsion/servo drive.
intentional_changes: Bought30x30x1mm carbon adapter supports FC25.5mm axes from a compact raised16mm saddle; two M2x6 lower fasteners and four independent M2x20 FC studs/nuts. Exact undimensioned cutouts are not invented. Seller0.72g mass is independent of clearance-envelope volume.

Three role-specific integral rail carriers replace identical54x74mm plates. Continuous battery and navigation/radio adhesive support avoids duplicating perforated carbon with unnecessary insulating plates.
FC lowest-component allowance remains8mm above carbon; actual PCB, dampers, spacers and upper retention remain unverified.

Fixed optical portal and roll support fuse into selected carrier. Remove separate OpticalMountBase and its two foot screw/nut pairs. Transfer moving head by exchanging low/portal carrier variants; fixed portal remains during staged device extraction.

Accessory station−159mm provides clearance to direct MG-F10 helix for both optical sensors/hosts and keeps its18mm shoe2mm inside rail. Only2mm nominal outward trim remains; full deck may overhang the rail.

Optional power uses one integral replacement carrier with unperforated40x56mm deck. Accessory portal rotates−45deg to clear radio connectors; other host portals keep their original diagonal. No attachment hardware added.
Retain340mm rail, functional rail coupling, propulsion/output bearing frame and separately replaceable paired servo/input module. 65 protected physical objects and coupons are independently compared.

Fix numerical tangent-face classification in diagonal translation sweeps and exact low-carrier metadata restoration after optical host round trips. Preview avoids unnecessary carrier reconstruction for an unchanged host.
important_design_iterations: Flat shared25.5mm saddle rejected because carbon would be mechanically redundant; raised16mm support makes the purchased plate structural.
M2x8 lower screws replaced by M2x6 to retain nominal2.9mm rail clearance.
Accessory−126 blocked conservative direct-helix optical field on FC-host optical configurations;−152 cleared optics but failed rail clamp-land placement.−159 passes both.
The first accessory placement probe was invalidated because native X expression reset the test translation. Subsequent probe clears the disposable expression and asserts actual−159 after recompute.
Diagonal optional accessory power portal blocked Mini connector lane. Host-specific−45deg portal preserves a simple one-piece shape and clears that lane.

Initial preview timed out while reconstructing integral carriers for every unchanged view. Source now changes carrier variants only when switching hosts; final preview must complete with fresh bound evidence.

Final native tests exposed the raised FC terminal entry overlapping the wiring band outside its unchanged R8 exception. Midpoint shifted from(-42,±12,40)to(-40,±12,42)mm; full saved-CAD probe cleared both optical hosts with2.839832mm minimum portal gap and zero outside-terminal overlap. Production clearance thresholds were unchanged. The earlier incomplete native/pipeline attempts are superseded, not accepted passes.
physical_limits: CAD fit prototype, not manufacturing/flight release. Carbon cutout contact, laminate strength and received dimensions unverified.
PA12 print fit, rail flexure/retention/creep, optical pointing and adhesive loads require physical qualification.
Actual FC soft-mount stack, motor/servo wires, gear set screws, shaft fits, fastener engagement, hardware mass, electrical power and RF behavior remain unresolved as declared in source.
Mass comparison concerns modeled prints/hardware only, includes newly modeled FC retention and seller carbon reference; not measured or all-up mass.

final_verification.status: CAD prototype verification passed; physical qualification remains unresolved

baseline_lineage.pin_review: Bounded saved-file review:281 unaffected shape records unchanged; only two wire reserves and their aggregate changed. Paired route contracts changed only the intermediate point; no source clearance threshold changed.

freecad_display.method: FreeCAD AppImage --single-instance with explicit saved file; FreeCAD 1.1.3 window observed. No GUI save performed.
